Bill Crow has enjoyed a multi-faceted music career. His successful performing career as a bassist allowed him into the inner circle of great jazz musicians where he became fascinated with the stories they had to share. His recent book Jazz Anecdotes gathers these marvelous tales for the public and has established Bill as a major jazz writer. His articles and reviews have appeared in Down Beat and Jazz Review. Bill also finds time to be an officer for the American Federation of Musicians Local 802, where he represents the interests of performing musicians in a rapidly changing industry.
Bill was interviewed in New York City on October 18, 1995 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
